NETWORK  egress — private netns (one per sandbox) with a pasta helper.
         host loopback   UNREACHABLE (--map-host-loopback none, -T none, -U none)
         abstract unix   UNREACHABLE (netns-scoped)
         pathname sockets (X11, D-Bus, Wayland, ssh-agent) — see FILESYSTEM,
                         not this block; a directory grant can expose one
         egress          full, IPv4 + IPv6
         dns             NONE — no resolver is named inside; lookups fail fast
                         (this profile grants egress but never asked for DNS)
         host -> sandbox CLOSED — nothing is forwarded into this
                         namespace. A door a human can open is declared with
                         listen_names in a profile; see below.
         address         copied from the host — and the seal below adds every
                         OTHER address the host owns, on every host interface, so
                         `ip addr` inside inventories the docker/podman/libvirt
                         bridges and a VPN's internal address as well as the LAN
                         one. Accepted disclosure, and it is wider than one address.
         host's own IPs  UNREACHABLE, by design — sealed as local routes inside the
                         sandbox's own network namespace (a /32 for IPv4, a /128
                         for IPv6, every address the host owns on every interface,
                         both families), so a connect to one short-circuits to
                         local delivery and is refused; this covers the host's own
                         link-local address too, which pasta does not copy onto
                         snug0 itself.
